details.coherence_justification: The candidate summary demonstrates strong internal logical coherence. All statements build upon each other without contradiction: revenue growth is explained by commercial agreements (S2-S3), profitability deterioration is attributed to non-operational adjustments (S4-S5-S6), and operational improvements are shown through operating loss contraction and adjusted EBITDA (S7-S9). The narrative flows logically from revenue transformation to financial impacts to operational performance and finally to financing and outlook. There are no self-contradictions, logical gaps, organizational problems, or unnecessary repetition. The relationships between revenue growth, expense items, and cash flow are consistently explained within the document itself.
